question_text: Was the Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage on Nov 23 a hack?
answer_text: Not established. Atlassian marked the outage resolved on Nov 23 and says it found the cause, but it has not said what the cause was. No one has claimed an attack and we found no report calling it one; no source has ruled one out.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An Atlassian post-incident report giving the cause, or a statement from a security authority or an outside investigator.

question_text: What caused the Bitbucket and Atlassian sign-in outage?
what_would_settle_it: An Atlassian post-incident report or other statement naming the cause.

answer_text: On Bitbucket, sign-in and Pipelines were partial outages; the website, API and Git access showed operational. The same sign-in incident is posted for Jira, Jira Service Management, Trello, Confluence and Atlassian's developer platform.
label: Confirmed

answer_text: Yes. Atlassian marked the incident resolved at 3:44 PM ET on Nov 23, about five and a half hours after it began, and says the service is operating normally for all affected customers.
label: Confirmed
